reason: The text fragment depicts the golden calf incident (Exodus 32), which is fundamentally a religious conflict centered on covenant fidelity. The passage emphasizes religious transgression (idolatry), divine command ('Thus says the Lord, God of Israel'), and covenantal blessing/judgment. There are no elements of political struggle for liberty present in the narrative—the conflict is entirely within a religious and covenantal framework regarding proper worship and allegiance to YHWH.
